title: Oswaldo Probable NDE 7464
content: I was selling incense with a friend in a street in the city center and they mistook me, and stabbed me from behind and also my friend. I got up and ran, overwhelmed with panic and losing a lot of blood from the wounds. I got into a taxi at the red traffic lights, while my friend also got up and got in the taxi. From that moment, (I) he began to feel very dizzy and feeling very sick, and panicked. Everything was yellow with descending giant black drops. When we arrived at the hospital, I fell unconscious. The hospital porters picked me up, put me on a trolley, and started to yell. Gradually I lost consciousness again. I began to hear and experience a type of regression, like a film. I saw all the religious deities from the subconscious. A friend said to me that death is like a web that looks like a daisy and that we go in a vehicle through a metallic web, continuing to the Earth. He said, that Death is like a daisy that doesn't exist, and fortuitously the daisy tried to say an illusion, or maybe that death is an illusion. I also saw the religious deities Jesus, the Virgin Mary, Krishna: experiencing that they exist in real life. Then I saw a pool, with a four-cornered tomb in the middle. The person was saying to me to throw myself into the tomb, which was joined to the pool. He tried to throw me, but then I saw a sort of tunnel, or a kind of dark opening that tried to suck me in. I panicked. I tried many times but the fear stopped me from jumping in. I entered another dimension, seeing puppies digging around on their stomachs, suffering like me, or myself. Something very strange occurred as I began to live my childhood playing with my friends. In the green meadows, it was as if I, myself, or something had to test my spiritual level. I was shown that my childhood could have been lived as if every moment was beautiful. He surprised me with such a profound realization as he was saying goodbye to the surgeon and me, but they wanted me to go. It was a beautiful, deep sleep in a state of peace and harmony. I imagine that, if I had said goodbye I would have stayed in this incomparable, relaxed trance state. Then I heard the surgeon say to me that I was fixed to my trolley. I mentioned my spiritual master, that I had found my religion. He told me that I was in very good shape being saved from the operation. They had stitched up the stomach, with various probes in each wound. He said that when they took me to intensive care and under anesthetics, I had experienced the suffering of the Earth, like a purgatory that you suffer and feel pain. At that point, you are alleviated or you are purified. I would have really preferred to remain unconscious in this state eternally, without pain or suffering, totally disconnected from this material plane. But it was a great teaching, sometimes difficult to describe. I feel that one has to experience it personally. However, many, whilst in these experiences, can't tolerate the pain and go. While others, such as ourselves, remain here in this World. I reflect and trying to live as a harmonious non-violent human being without war and aware of everything surrounding us indestructible. I feel compelled to never destroy anything and to live life as healthily as possible, linking with the supreme.
